description: Record sensor readings for a shipment — position, temperature, humidity, shock, tilt, light, battery — up to 500 per call. Aeroz judges the whole recent stream against the lane's thresholds immediately and returns the assessment and any findings raised. A shipment in `planned` moves to `in_transit` on its first reading. Readings from a logger read out at the dock are accepted after `delivered` if they fall inside the journey (departure − 60 min to arrival + 60 min); a cancelled shipment accepts none. Each logger (`source`) is judged on its own; the assessment reports the worst logger and every logger in temp.by_source, plus unobserved minutes. More than 500 readings, future readings and duplicates are refused or ignored and counted.
name: log_telemetry
title: Log telemetry
